title: Returns Desk Ruling: Repeat Changed-Mind Returns on One Northgate Special Order Purchase
content:
This ruling of the Northgate Purchases & Returns returns desk applies to a changed-mind refund of Northgate Special Order merchandise on a sale line that earned no Annual Reward, where the same purchase has already had changed-mind refunds.

## Ruling

Repeat changed-mind return on the purchase: when the purchase already carries two or more changed-mind refunds, 3 more percentage points are withheld; when it carries exactly one, 1.5 more points are withheld; otherwise no more points are withheld; changed-mind refunds on other purchases do not count.

- **Changed-mind refunds already carried** are the refund entries with return reason changed mind already booked on this purchase before the refund being worked.
- **The points** are percentage points of the returned value (the units on the received authorization multiplied by the sale line's unit price). Every percentage point withheld from the returned value forms one percentage, applied once to the returned value; the amount withheld is rounded half up to the cent and subtracted from the returned value.

| Changed-mind refunds already on this purchase | Points withheld |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 3 |
| exactly 1 | 1.5 |
| none | 0 |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical histories)

- A purchase with one earlier changed-mind refund and a returned value of 600.00: 1.5 points withheld, 9.00.
- A purchase with no earlier changed-mind refund, on a membership whose other purchases carry five: nothing withheld here, refunds on other purchases not counting.
- A purchase whose earlier refunds were for defective merchandise only: none of them is a changed-mind refund, so nothing is withheld.
